sources.title: Epigenome editing by a CRISPR-Cas9-based acetyltransferase activates genes from promoters and enhancers.
notes: Confirmed OA on PMC (PMC4430400) via Europe PMC, but this sandbox's direct HTTP access to europepmc.org/pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov PDF endpoints returns 404/bot-check, and NCBI FTP oa_pdf link was unavailable for this record (only tgz package offered). Downgraded to optional; corpus already has other foundational CRISPRa papers (Konermann 2013, comparative dCas9-VP64 analysis) covering equivalent control-design rationale.
